H9001.def: Verbal vav: joined to verb with no intervening prefix (usually conversive)  (futurepast)

H9002.def: Conjunctive vav -  i.e. followed by prefix, suffix or non-verb (conjunctive) (‘and/but’)

H9008.def: Prefix hé interrogative: at the start of a question

H9009.def: Prefix hé article: "the" for a subject, not object

H9010.def: Suffix aleph: definite article "the" in Aramaic

H9017.def: Punctuation Pe paragraph: ends a literary section

H9018.def: Punctuation Sameq paragraph: ends a lectionary section

H9019.def: Punctuation Inverted Nun paragraph: ends a lectionary section
